storylines.title: Dunc'd On: Steph's 44; AJ Debuts; NYK @ CHI; NBA Cup Outlook
storylines.summary: Nate and Danny break down Stephen Curry's 44-point night in Minnesota, AJ Dybantsa's NBA debut against Cleveland, and the Knicks' comeback in Chicago. They also discuss what Anthony Edwards' injury means for the Wolves, Cooper Flagg's strong start and Dallas' decision on Zaccharie Risacher, the latest news, and their NBA Cup group and wild-card picks. 0:30 Stephen Curry's 44 and Yaxel Lendeborg's breakout in Minnesota 9:09 Anthony Edwards' injury and the Wolves' outlook without him 13:01 Cooper Flagg's strong start, Risacher's option and Dallas' future 18:47 AJ Dybantsa's debut and Washington's second-half problems in Cleveland 34:15 Cleveland's supporting cast, Evan Mobley's shooting and Philadelphia's comeback in Indiana 44:24 Knicks-Bulls: New York's comeback, Jalen Brunson and Chicago's defensive questions 53:13 Listener questions and news: Kingston Flemings, Naz Reid, Ja Morant and injury updates 1:01:32 NBA Cup format, group winners and wild-card predictions Join Dunc'd On Prime !
